## Parent

Part of [验证 Binance Spot Live 可信执行](https://github.com/kaiqiangh/tradex/issues/121); this slice's specification gate is [#130](https://github.com/kaiqiangh/tradex/issues/130). Starting implementation/review baseline `dev@1f8e231`; retain the standing single-ticket/public external seam and serial workflow.

## What to build

Deliver the owning fee and genuinely-required execution-FX statement end to end: the approval-bound contract, the derivation that consumes only the already-read declared commission rates and the proposal-scoped FX requirements, the single typed blocker contributed inside the approval review, the React current/captured/pre-arm display, and the paired RED/GREEN evidence. The delivered bounded FX producer supports only `EURUSD`/`USDEUR`, the workspace base currency can never be `USDT` (it must be exactly three letters) and the only permitted Spot instruments quote in `USDT`; the already-read account response does not establish the complete symbol/side commission or charging asset. The slice therefore states its reachability honestly instead of manufacturing a positive.

## Delivery log

- `57c4290` T01 contract layer: `RiskDecisionInputKind::SpotFeeFx`, `RiskDecision.spot_fee_fx`, `ApprovalReview.spot_fee_fx`, the `normalize_input_material` no-op arm, the `spot_fee_fx::derive` skeleton returning `Ok(None)`, and the review gate appended after the delivered owning gate under the same single activation predicate. Regenerated IPC schema; provably zero behaviour change (492 Rust / 0 failed / 39 pre-existing ignored).
- `4bd6f2f` T02 statement derivation: full `derive`, the `SpotDeclaredCommission` projection of the already-validated `commissionRates`, the read-only proposal-scoped FX evidence accessor, exact-decimal comparison basis (not an all-in fee estimate), required-route narrowing and qualification, the single binding blocker with route precedence, and the `None` fail-closed branch. Three public `owning_fee_fx_*` cases RED then GREEN (495 Rust / 0 failed / 39 pre-existing ignored).

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] AC1. The contract and derivation layers are delivered and bound: `RiskDecisionInputKind::SPOT_FEE_FX`, `RiskDecision.spot_fee_fx`, `ApprovalReview.spot_fee_fx` and the regenerated schema agree across Rust, JSON Schema and TypeScript.
- [x] AC2. `derive` consumes only the bound capacity observation's declared commission rates, the proposal-scoped FX requirements and the current FX observation. `spot_capacity`'s existing unknown-key account-extension obligation is preserved verbatim alongside the new projection.
- [x] AC3. The required-route set is narrowed to the intent-policy route plus the intent-funding route for a BUY only; the portfolio-scoped rows are excluded.
- [x] AC4. The declared maker/taker comparison basis (not an all-in fee estimate) is selected by exact decimal comparison, proven by a case whose maker and taker rates are numerically equal but lexically different, with no `f64` and no rounding.
- [x] AC5. Exactly one typed binding blocker is reported with route precedence over the fee-class facts, and the non-binding fact stays reported.
- [x] AC6. The review gate reuses the delivered owning activation predicate and appends a single-line blocker after the delivered owning blocker, leaving the delivered `SPOT_OWNING_QUALIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE` branch and every existing assertion untouched.
- [x] AC7. Prepare refuses with `RISK_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE` with no reservation and no partial state, and a change to the fee or route evidence changes `approval_review_digest`.
- [x] AC8. The four fee-class reason codes and the identity-mismatch `Ok(None)` case are covered by derivation-contract unit tests inside the module and documented as not reachable through the public seam.
- [x] AC9. The `extension_keys` bound is documented as bounded disclosure and proven to leave the unknown-key obligation intact.
- [x] AC10. Actual React current/captured/pre-arm states both independent reasons, names each number's declared origin, keeps `USDT != USD` literal, offers no refresh control, and is not renewed by a later read. Keyboard 1280/768/390 without overflow and no console errors.
- [x] AC11. Paired bilingual evidence, the paired specification and design, the S29 plan and the map reflect the honest end state: this slice is not a positive path and the parent stays OPEN. Independent serial Standards then Spec review and exact source/evidence/remote/tracker handoff close the slice.

## Blocked by

No open blocker. The delivered owning admission statement and the delivered exact-account capacity/interval reads are the actual native dependencies this slice consumes.

## Standing boundaries

No new read, host, route, credential or saved source. No relaxation of the bounded FX producer's supported pairs, no currency parity, and no widening of the base-currency validator. The delivered `CURRENCY_CONVERSION` semantics are unchanged. Full-goal scope remains; real transactions need concrete separate approval and human action, and `main` is human-reviewed PR only after full-map verification.

## Current full-goal boundary (2026-10-10)

This zero-new-read statement/refusal slice does not waive the original positive fee/FX capability. BOTH complete symbol/side commission and charging-currency evidence AND genuinely required USDT execution FX remain mandatory owning work. The ordinary host already has an official symbol commission API; no claim of provider capability absence is made. Source statement acceptance is separate from full financial qualification.

Part of [验证 Binance Spot Live 可信执行](https://github.com/kaiqiangh/tradex/issues/121). Starting implementation/review baseline `dev@1f8e231`; retain the standing single-ticket/public external seam and serial workflow. Actual completed dependencies are the owning Spot admission statement (S29.8) and the exact-account capacity/interval reads (S29.5/S29.6) it consumes.

## What to build

Give the owning Binance Spot Live PLACE path one more precise, current statement: the fee this intent would incur and the execution conversions this intent genuinely requires. The statement consumes only what has already been read - the declared `commissionRates` inside the bound capacity observation, the proposal-scoped FX requirements and the current FX observation - and never adds a read, host, route, credential or saved source. The fee basis is the conservative declared basis selected by exact decimal comparison; no fee amount is ever fabricated, because the venue declares commission *rates* and not the fee-charging *asset*. The required routes are narrowed to the intent path and, for a BUY only, the funding path. Both the fee evidence and the required routes are approval-bound, so a genuine change changes the approval review digest and re-admission needs a new review. When either fact cannot be established the statement fails closed with its single typed blocker and Prepare refuses with `RISK_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE`. No new authority: no Arm, consent, dispatch, probe order or source mutation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] AC1. The fee statement and the genuinely-required execution-FX statement are derived only from already-bound seams: the declared `commissionRates` inside the bound capacity observation, the proposal-scoped FX requirements and the current FX observation. No new read, host, route, credential or saved source is added, and no renderer-supplied rate, fee, asset, route or qualification is accepted.
- [x] AC2. Identity binding mirrors the owning statement: workspace / Proposal / proposal hash / account / instrument / BASE / QUOTE / rule-material / source-generation are compared against each other, while each observation version is validated against its own cursor and folded into the two statement version digests. Any mismatch retires the evidence instead of being reconciled by assumption.
- [x] AC3. The required-route set is narrowed to the genuinely-required routes only: the intent-policy route always, and the intent-funding route only for a BUY. The portfolio-scoped account/balance/position/open-order rows stay the read-only review context's domain and are not silently folded into this statement.
- [x] AC4. The declared fee basis is the conservative one, selected by exact decimal comparison and never by string comparison, with no `f64` and no rounding that could make a fee smaller than the venue's own figure. When the venue does not declare the fee-charging asset the currency is reported as UNKNOWN with its origin, and no fee amount is fabricated.
- [x] AC5. Exactly one typed binding blocker is reported. When a structurally-unsupported required route and an undeclared fee currency co-occur, the route binds first, and the fee-currency fact remains a reported fact that is never silently dropped.
- [x] AC6. Missing, unsupported, mismatched, stale or version-changed evidence fails closed with `RISK_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE` semantics at approval review and at Prepare; the statement never degrades into a smaller or more forgiving number, and the delivered `CURRENCY_CONVERSION` semantics are left unchanged.
- [x] AC7. The statement is approval-bound: a genuine change to the fee evidence or to a required route changes `approval_review_digest` and leaves the review ineligible, so re-admission requires a newly reviewed approval. A refusal leaves the Proposal and approval untouched, with no reservation and no partial state.
- [x] AC8. Actual React current/captured/pre-arm states both independent reasons in plain language, names the declared origin of every reported number, keeps `USDT != USD` literally true, exposes no refresh control, and is neither renewed nor repaired by a later get, refresh or reopen. Keyboard layout is correct at 1280/768/390 without overflow.
- [x] AC9. Reachability is stated rather than assumed. `RiskCheckOutcome::Pass` and `SPOT_FEE_FX_QUALIFIED` are retained in the contract but are unreachable at the public seam with the delivered bounded FX producer (only `EURUSD`/`USDEUR`) and the delivered fixed ordinary hosts (the already-read account response does not establish a charging asset); the fee-class reason codes and the identity-mismatch case are therefore covered by derivation-contract unit tests and not by public product tests. No producer, supported pair, currency parity or base-currency validator is relaxed to manufacture a positive.
- [x] AC10. Genuine public RED/GREEN, external normal/incomplete/contradictory/lifecycle tests, current full and affected suites, generated schema and paired bilingual traceability, ordinary build/pin, actual frozen UI, independent serial Standards then Spec review, and exact source/evidence/remote/tracker handoff establish this slice. The parent, S28, S17, physical S27, S33 and the `dev` to `main` merge stay OPEN.

## Blocked by

No open blocker. The completed owning admission statement and the completed exact-account capacity/interval reads are the actual native dependencies this statement consumes. No invented S28 or physical gate edge.

## Standing boundaries

Use the paired S29.9 specification and design published on the parent. The confirmed single-ticket granularity and the highest public React/Rust/disposable-storage/external-provider seam apply unchanged. This slice does not constitute a positive path: the Binance Spot Live authorization path remains unavailable at the approval review gate with the currently delivered inputs, which is correct fail-closed behaviour and not a PASS. Full-goal scope remains; real transactions need concrete separate approval and human action, and `main` is human-reviewed PR only after full-map verification.

## Current full-goal boundary (2026-10-10)

This zero-new-read statement/refusal slice does not waive the original positive fee/FX capability. BOTH complete symbol/side commission and charging-currency evidence AND genuinely required USDT execution FX remain mandatory owning work. The ordinary host already has an official symbol commission API; no claim of provider capability absence is made. Source statement acceptance is separate from full financial qualification.

121.body:
## Problem Statement

Binance Spot Live is available as an ordinary-account connection, but read-only authentication and existing order observations do not deliver the complete trusted execution path. Production crypto quote/venue/rule evidence, account restrictions, Live PLACE dispatch, private-stream recovery and separately authorized real-provider acceptance remain incomplete. The user explicitly selected S29 before the blocked S28 acceptance; that changes scheduling only.

## Solution

Deliver Binance Spot Live through the existing trusted TradeX Control Plane and isolated Order Execution Gateway. Show each account's actual permissions, trading restrictions and evidence gaps. Require current, exact instrument/rule/quote/venue/time and genuinely needed FX evidence, explicit Arm and an immutable single-use financial approval before a bounded Spot order. Preserve provider truth, fills, fees, capacity and query-first recovery. Keep local contract/fault evidence distinct from real-provider financial acceptance.

## User Stories

1. As a user, I want to reuse my saved Binance Live connection, so that I do not re-enter keys for a read-only refresh.
2. As a user, I want Live and historical Testnet identities kept separate, so that no operation is routed to the wrong environment.
3. As a user, I want complete current API-key scope and IP restrictions shown, so that successful reads are not mistaken for trading permission.
4. As a user, I want withdrawal, transfer and unsupported derivative permissions to block execution, so that the application retains its Spot boundary.
5. As a user, I want Binance system maintenance and exact-account trading locks shown, so that I understand account-specific execution blockers.
6. As a user, I want missing, malformed or failed status reads shown as incomplete, so that they are never interpreted as normal operation.
7. As a user, I want status changes to invalidate prior execution readiness and consent, so that old authority cannot survive a degraded account.
8. As a user, I want exact BTC/USDT and ETH/USDT trading rules and permission-set constraints, so that unsupported or halted instruments are not offered as tradable.
9. As a user, I want authentic bid/ask, quantities, depth sequencing and provider timestamps, so that a last-trade price or receipt time is not substituted for executable liquidity evidence.
10. As a user, I want stale, crossed, discontinuous or disconnected market evidence blocked, so that trade checks fail closed.
11. As a user, I want venue/source/connection generations bound to evidence, so that switching sources retires earlier quotes and approvals.
12. As a user, I want data rights and regional access limitations stated, so that public access is not treated as licence or jurisdiction approval.
13. As a user, I want Binance time/signature checks performed against the fixed ordinary endpoint, so that routing or clock errors do not bypass safety.
14. As a user, I want original BASE/QUOTE and fee currencies retained, so that USDT is never assumed to equal USD.
15. As a user, I want FX checked only for actual required conversions with execution quality and cost, so that irrelevant conversions are not invented and required ones are not skipped.
16. As a user, I want explicit account Arm separate from financial approval, so that selecting Live does not authorize an order.
17. As a user, I want an immutable Proposal with maximum authorized spend, fees and risk decisions, so that approval authorizes exactly the reviewed intent.
18. As a user, I want Prepare to atomically consume approval and reserve capacity, so that concurrent orders cannot overspend.
19. As a user, I want dispatch through the authenticated child Gateway after durable SUBMITTING, so that generic model/tool access cannot place orders.
20. As a user, I want exactly one provider mutation for each consumed grant, so that retries cannot duplicate orders.
21. As a user, I want uncertain submissions queried by their persisted client order ID, so that absence or timeout cannot trigger automatic resubmission.
22. As a user, I want exact cancellation approval and current provider order evidence, so that cancellation never applies to another order or stale intent.
23. As a user, I want ACK, fill and cancellation separated and fees settled exactly once, so that capacity is not released before broker truth.
24. As a user, I want private-stream gaps repaired with identity-bound REST reconciliation, so that a disconnected stream does not leave fictitious current state.
25. As a user, I want crash, restart, lock and wake to disarm and recover read-only, so that interrupted work is never replayed automatically.
26. As a user, I want account faults isolated and shared-policy changes to affect all bound accounts, so that safety and recovery have the correct scope.
27. As a user, I want keyboard and narrow-screen controls to retain all blockers, so that financial consent remains accessible and deliberate.
28. As a user, I want actual Live transactions performed only under a concrete separately approved plan, so that development consent is not trading consent.
29. As a reviewer, I want exact-SHA local, ordinary-native and real-provider evidence labelled separately, so that fixtures cannot close hosted acceptance.
30. As a reviewer, I want S28, S17 and physical S27 gates preserved, so that the scheduling exception does not waive release requirements.

## Implementation Decisions

- English RevC PRD, UI §14 and Backend §41–42 remain authoritative; synchronize financial, wire and evidence contracts in Chinese.
- Reuse the agreed single-ticket vertical-slice workflow and existing public UI → typed Control Plane → temporary SQLite/outbox seam with external secure-vault/HTTP/WS fakes. No hidden positive financial snapshot seeding. Positive financial dispatch later uses the real isolated authenticated child Gateway and loopback fake provider.
- Execute serially: (1) ordinary-account trading-state diagnostics and safety consumption; (2) configured Binance venue/rule/market evidence; (3) trusted Live PLACE/private-stream lifecycle and fault recovery; (4) complete ordinary-native/read-only acceptance and concrete authorized financial handoff. Publish only the current implementation ticket, then reassess the next complete slice after its review. The existing confirmed granularity/seam convention is retained.
- First slice reads public system status and signed account API trading status during the existing connection/probe/refresh path. Persist bounded typed evidence with local receipt time distinct from provider lock update time. An unlocked account and normal system response do not certify instrument liquidity, licence, complete permissions or Live readiness.
- Missing historical evidence, locks, maintenance and failed reads must never support Arm/PLACE. Recovery remains read-only and disarmed. Existing independent CANCEL/unknown-order reconciliation evidence paths must remain available under their existing guard contracts.
- Ordinary Binance host only; no Testnet fallback, alternate regional host or access bypass. Unsupported responses fail closed.
- S29 has shared implementation prerequisites S06/S08/S19/S21–S27; S28 is not a technical dependency. The unresolved physical S27 acceptance remains a release gate.

## Testing Decisions

- Exercise public connect/probe/refresh/get/list/reopen and existing financial guard commands, not private parser calls or directly seeded account rows.
- Record RED before GREEN for the first new external behavior. Cover normal, maintenance, account lock, missing/wrong-type/unknown flags, malformed provider times, stale/state-conflict results, recovery, persistence and environment isolation.
- Check endpoint/method/signature/secret boundaries at the fake external provider. Do not execute real financial requests for tests.
- Validate the actual React Accounts surface against the isolated real Rust Control Plane, including keyboard and narrow layouts; ordinary native evidence is distinct.
- Require sequential independent Standards then Spec reviews and current checks bound to delivery SHA. Complete S29 closure also requires authorized hosted lifecycle evidence, not just local test success.

## Out of Scope

Margin/futures/leverage, transfers/withdrawals/custody, arbitrary assets, implicit stablecoin parity, licence purchases, jurisdiction bypass, Testnet hosted acceptance, Bitget S30, changes to S28 gates, and automatic merge to main.

## Further Notes

Starting dev SHA: fe20d0aae1c0eea9df43c1e24f32199a92ff30b9. The user selected S29 on 2026-10-07; S28 remains OPEN. S29 remains OPEN until all listed behaviors and real-provider gates are satisfied.

Primary API references checked 2026-10-07: [Binance Wallet account API](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/catalog/core-trading-wallet/api/rest-api/account), [system status](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/catalog/core-trading-wallet/api/rest-api/others), [Spot rules](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/catalog/core-trading-spot-trading/api/rest-api/general), [Spot market streams](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/catalog/core-trading-spot-trading/api/ws-streams/~). Endpoint-specific inspection is repeated when implementing each later slice; unexamined API behavior is not a delivery claim.

# S29.3 — Binance Spot Hot quote and continuous-depth source

Parent: [Verify trusted Binance Spot Live execution](https://github.com/kaiqiangh/tradex/issues/121). Starting implementation/review baseline: dev@5edf18d01122d1871b6c94aeafefe708435b7f38. Previous rule-source/admission ticket #123 is CLOSED; parent S29 remains OPEN. This specification advances parent stories 9–12 and 27 without removing its full execution/hosted acceptance requirements.

## Problem Statement

The ordinary Binance connection and exact Spot rule source cannot supply current bid/ask liquidity. The production Hot source currently handles Alpaca equities only. A Binance account link, last trade, public book ticker or unsequenced REST snapshot cannot provide a timestamped continuous book. Users need exact venue/source provenance and clear lifecycle/failure/rights states before later financial checks can consume authentic liquidity evidence.

## Solution

Configure the ordinary Binance public Spot market source independently of execution credentials. In a visible Hot BTC/USDT or ETH/USDT view, acquire one bounded, versioned quote lease, bootstrap a provider depth snapshot against buffered live updates, maintain a demonstrably continuous known book, and project exact prices, BASE sizes, coverage bands, original provider event time and first TradeX receipt. Expose technical collection separately from user-specific permitted data use. Retire evidence on discontinuity or source/time/lifecycle changes and recover through explicit, bounded operations. Reuse the existing typed Control Plane, source registry, Hot ownership and protected consumers.

## User Stories

1. As a user, I want a saved ordinary Binance Spot market-source selection, so that research does not silently fall back to Testnet or another host.
2. As a user, I want source settings independent of execution credentials, so that public market reads do not borrow or transmit my trading key.
3. As a user, I want Save and Disconnect to make no network request, so that choosing a source does not start hidden subscriptions.
4. As a user, I want explicit source coverage for canonical BTC/USDT and ETH/USDT, so that unsupported assets remain unavailable.
5. As a user, I want a visible Hot view to own one bounded lease, so that background universes do not consume tick subscriptions.
6. As a user, I want a connected socket distinguished from a usable continuous book, so that a handshake alone does not produce a quote.
7. As a user, I want original provider event time, TradeX receipt and update identity separately retained, so that cache reads cannot manufacture freshness.
8. As a user, I want exact best bid/ask and BASE quantities, so that quote amounts never become invented USD values.
9. As a user, I want bounded depth and known coverage bands visible, so that a partial initial snapshot is not described as the entire order book.
10. As a user, I want gaps, malformed/crossed books and time faults to retire usable evidence, so that later checks fail closed.
11. As a user, I want duplicate or obsolete events ignored without freshening prior material, so that replay cannot renew consent.
12. As a user, I want disconnect/reconnect to bootstrap a new generation before showing current liquidity, so that old quotes do not survive a stream gap.
13. As a user, I want stop, navigation, hidden view, source change and workspace close to release ownership, so that late workers cannot publish into another context.
14. As a user, I want retry limits, cooldowns and terminal access failures explained, so that the app cannot repeatedly hammer a denied endpoint.
15. As a user, I want live technical latency distinguished from data-use permission, retention, redistribution, commercial use and regional eligibility, so that public access does not imply a licence.
16. As a user, I want source generations and immutable quote/depth identities included in backend reviews, so that source or material changes invalidate old evidence where applicable.
17. As a user, I want owning quote checks to consume authentic Binance provenance without requiring an invented last trade, so that later financial execution can use the intended source.

Verify, at the public seam: complete and current declared capacity accepting exactly the available amount; one unit beyond it rejected; incomplete classification, incomplete order/list coverage and unresolved obligations failing closed; a locked figure that contradicts the declared open-order inventory failing closed; BUY using QUOTE and SELL using BASE with the stated unit; an exhausted interval window blocking Prepare; a remaining slot of exactly one accepting one attempt and rejecting the second; unknown, malformed or non-integer counts and limits failing closed; an interval association that cannot be shown to remain in its original window making the quota not evaluable; per-account isolation under concurrent prepares; provider-declared evidence never releasing a local reservation; pending, failure, binding change, rule-material change, source-generation change, reopen, stale and newer-owner results retiring the qualification; a later get or refresh never renewing a captured qualification; and every positive case still lacking Arm, consent, dispatch or any new authority.

Replay the actual current, captured and pre-arm views plus the representative rejection and recovery paths at keyboard 1280/768/390 without overflow.

Require the current full and affected rule/capacity/interval/Hot/Gateway suites, generated IPC and paired traceability, the ordinary desktop build and pin, independent serial Standards then Spec review, and exact source/evidence/remote/tracker handoff. Native, provider, financial, physical, prototype and main evidence remain separately labelled and unclaimed.

## Out of Scope

Real Binance fee and genuinely required execution-grade FX inputs, reference-price streaming, immediate authenticated execution preflight, execution-expiry and private-stream lifecycle implementation, immutable financial intent changes beyond consuming the existing approval, actual orders/probes/Arm/consent beyond the existing approved guards, new accounts or source configuration, rights grants, S28/Testnet/Bitget scope changes, the physical S27 sleep waiver, prototype fixes and the main merge. These remain later owning work, not waived.

## Further Notes

Primary contracts rechecked 2026-10-09: [rate limits and order-count limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binance/binance-spot-api-docs/master/rest-api.md#rate-limits), [current open orders](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binance/binance-spot-api-docs/master/rest-api.md#current-open-orders-user_data), [account information](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binance/binance-spot-api-docs/master/rest-api.md#account-information-user_data). Binance reports interval counts as original integers in the response envelope and documents `ORDERS` as a per-account order-rate limit; treating an unknown or incomplete read as available is this spec's explicit refusal, not a provider guarantee.

Actual technical dependencies are the completed exact-account capacity inputs and interval-quota inputs; the completed Proposal rule/reference slice supplies the instrument rules this qualification reports against. Full parent, map, S28, S17, physical S27 and main gates remain OPEN. Standing granularity and seam approvals apply; no repeated quiz.

S29.8 (#129) is closed. Paired specification: [`s29-owning-place-qualification-spec.md`](https://github.com/kaiqiangh/tradex/blob/dev/docs/implementation/s29-owning-place-qualification-spec.md) / [`_zh`](https://github.com/kaiqiangh/tradex/blob/dev/docs/implementation/s29-owning-place-qualification-spec_zh.md). Paired acceptance: [`evidence/s29-owning-place-qualification/`](https://github.com/kaiqiangh/tradex/tree/dev/docs/implementation/evidence/s29-owning-place-qualification). Delivery: source `375e1c0`, contracts and evidence `7246062` on `dev`.

**Corrections to the specification published above**, made because the independent Spec review found the published wording did not match the delivered and correct behaviour. The paired documents and Backend §41.48 carry the same corrections in both languages.

1. **Bound identity and `state_version`.** The published decision listed `state version` among the identity fields that are compared between the two inputs, reading as though the capacity and interval state versions had to match each other. They are deliberately *not* compared, and that is the correct behaviour: each state version is `sha256` over `[that observation struct, sequence]`, so two different endpoints' observations cannot produce equal digests. Requiring equality would have blocked even a fully current qualified intent rather than retiring stale evidence — the opposite of fail-closed. Each input's own state version is still enforced against its own expected cursor by the slice that produced it, and both are folded into the two evidence-version digests this qualification emits. The archived RED payload shows the two values differing (`d75337af…` capacity, `b0c2c2a5…` intervals). Workspace, Proposal, Proposal hash, account, instrument, BASE/QUOTE, rule material version and source generation remain compared as published.

2. **Declared origin of each number.** The published decision said the capacity projection would gain explicit availability and committed sources for this path. That was not delivered, and should not be: the PRD requires this statement to derive from the already-delivered read-only observations and never from a second projection, and this slice inherits the consumed slices unchanged. The delivered design names the declared origin in the qualification itself, as two typed values, and the statement was changed during review to attribute every reported figure to the venue read that declared it (open-order and balance inventory; order-rate counters) instead of showing one combined origin line. That change is renderer-only and required no IPC regeneration. The statement remains a single binding blocker that is a typed reason rather than free text.

3. **What the approval review does and does not bind.** Backend §41.48 also claimed the approval review digest deliberately excludes Spot evidence, so a time-sensitive statement could not invalidate an issued approval binding. That was factually wrong: `SpotCapacity` and `SpotOrderIntervals` are approval-bound like every other reviewed input except the reservation ledger and their declared figures are not normalized away, so a genuine change to that evidence — including an advance of the venue's own order-rate counter — changes the review digest and leaves the review ineligible. Prepare therefore refuses with `RISK_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE`, and admitting the intent again requires a newly reviewed approval. The behaviour is sound and was kept: the owning gate is always evaluated against a freshly derived evaluation, so no stale admission can be replayed. The ARD sentence now states the actual behaviour.

**AC8 read-out, stated explicitly.** AC8 asks that the capacity projection name the declared origin of each number with explicit typed availability/committed sources, and that the single blocker be a typed reason. The consumed projection already types its read origins (`SpotCapacityPurpose`, `SpotCapacityReadKind`), and this slice adds the qualification's typed per-number origin; no per-figure availability/committed subtraction was added, for the reason in correction 2.

**Acceptance.** Both public seams carry their own genuine RED/GREEN pair. The browser seam found a real contract defect that `cargo test` and `npm run schema:check` could not detect: a declared 64-character bound on a 71-character `sha256:` value made the whole `RiskDecision` payload undecodable in the application, because React decodes every response through the generated validators. Both bound evidence versions are now declared at 71 characters. Whole gate `npm run check` EXIT=0 with the integration server stopped: 492 Rust passed / 0 failed / 39 pre-existing ignored over 34 binaries, Node 17/17, Rust/JSON Schema/TypeScript agree, `Traceability OK: 203 requirements, 70 screens, 13 QA scenarios, 23 baseline files`. Independent serial Standards then Spec review is recorded in [`code-review-final.md`](https://github.com/kaiqiangh/tradex/blob/dev/docs/implementation/evidence/s29-owning-place-qualification/code-review-final.md): no scope creep, no fail-open, and the Standards axis also found four stale `docs/FILE_MANIFEST.md` hashes, which were corrected after re-hashing every row.

**Still open.** Fees and genuinely required execution FX, immediate authenticated execution preflight, the private-stream lifecycle and real-provider financial acceptance remain later owning work for S29. S29 parent, map, S28, S17 and the physical S27 waiver stay OPEN. Source acceptance for this slice is not parent, native, provider-hosted, financial, physical or main acceptance, and no real transaction was placed.
